name: v0.0.1 - Groups and media file support
body:
v0.0.1 now includes better support for group chats; sending and receiving media files including audio, video, and images; and better instructions for Windows.

Follow the instructions in the readme to get started

## What's Changed
* Support for group chats by @lharries in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/6
* Docs: update README.md by @eltociear in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/12
* Docs: add Windows compatibility instructions to README by @aastroza in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/11
* Update README.md by @alain-sv in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/22
* Improve date handling by @lharries in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/30
* Feat: send files and audio messages by @lharries in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/31
* Fix typo in README.md by @cs4alhaider in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/32
* Feat: handle incoming media (images, audio, videos, documents) and show names in group messages by @lharries in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/34

## New Contributors
* @lharries made their first contribution in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/6
* @eltociear made their first contribution in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/12
* @aastroza made their first contribution in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/11
* @alain-sv made their first contribution in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/22
* @cs4alhaider made their first contribution in https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp/pull/32
